title: A live blog of WWDC 2026, where Apple announced an overhauled Siri, a Siri app, new AI capabilities, OS updates focused on performance, and more (Engadget)
summary: Engadget: A live blog of WWDC 2026, where Apple announced an overhauled Siri, a Siri app, new AI capabilities, OS updates focused on performance, and more — We're covering the news live from the company's “All systems glow” event. — It's WWDC day, and this year, it's falling on a Monday.
contentText:
Engadget :

A live blog of WWDC 2026, where Apple announced an overhauled Siri, a Siri app, new AI capabilities, OS updates focused on performance, and more   —  We're covering the news live from the company's “All systems glow” event.  —  It's WWDC day, and this year, it's falling on a Monday.
